::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Renesas India designs automotive microcontrollers and analog ICs. Part of the Japanese chipmaker's global design network for automotive electronics. On 2025-05-13 Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw inaugurated Renesas' new Noida and Bengaluru design centres, which the government said would work on 3nm chip design (incl. R-Car automotive SoCs).
:::

## What does this firm design?

RH850 and RL78 automotive microcontrollers, analog power management ICs, and IoT connectivity solutions.

### Design Scores

| | Score | Made up of |

| **Ambition** | <span class="complexity-bar" title="Ambition: 3.5/5"><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment"></span></span> 3.5/5 | Domain difficulty 4, strategic depth 3 |
| **Progress** | <span class="complexity-bar" title="Progress: 3/5"><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment"></span><span class="complexity-segment"></span></span> 3/5 | Design completeness 4, India scale 2 |

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Raised 3->4: 3nm R-Car automotive SoC work plus analog/power; leading-node automotive is demanding.
- **Strategic depth 3/5:** Co-develops high-end automotive SoCs with other geographies; India does not own product lines outright.
- **Design completeness 4/5:** Multiple chip design teams cover MCU, analog and SoC work, including end-to-end 3nm design per MeitY.
- **India scale 2/5:** About 850 staff across four sites (Sept 2025), target 1,000 by end-2025.
